##### Project general facts

Aysha Residences is a refined waterfront development set within the prestigious Maryam Island masterplan, offering a seamless blend of coastal living and contemporary design. Positioned along the Al Khan Lagoon and directly connected to the promenade and beachfront, the six-storey building presents a collection of 137 residences, from studios to spacious three-bedroom apartments. The architecture draws inspiration from regional traditions, expressed through a calm palette of beige and brown tones, textured façades, and clean modern lines, creating a timeless and elegant presence by the water.

Residents enjoy a lifestyle shaped by connectivity, leisure, and natural surroundings. Direct access to the waterfront promenade brings a vibrant mix of cafés, dining, and outdoor experiences, while nearby Maryam Island Boulevard adds retail and social convenience. Landscaped green areas and scenic walkways create a relaxing environment, allowing residents to enjoy both the energy of a lively destination and the tranquility of a coastal retreat.

Interiors at Aysha Residences are designed with a focus on comfort and durability, featuring modern finishing and high-quality materials throughout. Porcelain tile flooring, gypsum ceilings in key areas, and soft neutral paint tones create a clean and bright atmosphere, while wood-finish carpentry adds warmth and character. Kitchens are available in open or closed layouts, fitted with laminated cabinetry, reconstituted stone countertops, and practical storage solutions. Bathrooms are equipped with contemporary sanitary ware and refined detailing. Residences are offered unfurnished, providing a flexible canvas for personalized living.

##### Location description and benefits

Located just across Aysha Residences, Maryam Island’s waterfront promenade provides residents with direct access to Al Khan lagoon. Offering a variety of retail and entertainment facilities for residents and visitors, the promenade will be a place for residents to meet, interact, exercise, and enjoy all that a waterfront lifestyle has to offer.

Maryam Island is located in downtown Sharjah overlooking the Arabian Sea. It provides easy access to Sharjah and the neighbouring Emirates of Dubai, Ajman, and Umm Al Quwain via the Al Taawun and Al Ittihad Roads.

Set to take the tourism industry of Sharjah by storm, Maryam Island promises to be the ultimate leisure and lifestyle destination with a range of alluring amenities and unique gastronomical offerings. Combined with the utmost privacy, the serene residential spaces offer visitors, tenants, owners, and guests the experience of a lifetime, with a relaxing promenade and a wealth of upscale amenities.
